summary: WF International Ltd. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $5.5 million registered direct offering of 5,000,000 ordinary shares at $1.10 per share to certain investors under a September 10, 2026 share purchase agreement. The subscription price reflects a steep discount to the $4.17 close on September 10, 2026, and to the 60-day high of $7.90. Shares trade on Nasdaq under WXM. The company is a PRC-based issuer; no board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch dilution and PRC/CSRC filing compliance risk.
